en_US: Documentaries and drama with me,
your Variety Hour host!
The Variety Channel that’s a treasure
chest filled with laughter and tears!

Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 1: “Angry Maximo”
...Argh! I hate that! I really hate all
of that!
Narrator: This is Maximo.
He’s the leader of this town’s toughest
group of guys, the “Hard Punch.”
Maximo: Every day is so boring!
Pokémon battles are so boring!
It makes me so mad, I’m going to throw
this rock! Haraaagh!!
Narrator: Clunk, clink!
Maximo: Argh! That makes me so angry!
Narrator: Just then he heard a strange
voice from behind him...
???: Hey you. Knock it off.
Narrator: It was a mysterious old man.
He grabbed Maximo by the arm. Just who is
this old man anyway...?
Tune in next time for Episode 2,
“The Screaming Old Man”!

Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 2: “The Screaming Old Man”
Old man: Quit trying to break things.
It’s impossible to break rocks...
Quit doing these useless things.
What you need to do is...compete in
the Pokéathlon!
Narrator: The mysterious old man who
appeared out of nowhere suddenly rushed
at the young Maximo...
Maximo: Hey! Watch it!
Narrator: Pew pew! The old man’s
attacks were fast, but the young
Maximo’s reflexes were as well...
Maximo: I said knock it off, old man!
Old man: ...Humph. It looks like you’ve
got the talent to participate in the
Pokéathlon... Well, train with me and I’ll
turn you into a Pokéathlete!
Maximo: You think I know anything about
that noise?!
Narrator: Maximo shook off the
mysterious old man and ran away...
Tune in next time for Episode 3,
“Unforgettable Emotions”!

Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 3: “Unforgettable Emotions”
Old man: You’ve got the talent to
compete in the Pokéathlon! You should
train with me, and I’ll show you!
Narrator: Even though the young Maximo
ran away from the difficult old man,
he couldn’t shake those words.
He walked alone around the town
contemplating.
Maximo: Aw, man! Why does it bother me
what that old guy says anyway?
And what in the world is a “Pokéathlon”?
Narrator: Maximo kicked a radio someone
dropped in the street.
Radio: ...Piii... Gagagagaga...
Here’s... Player arrived... Goal!
...It’s a new world record!
Maximo: Wh-what in the world is that?
Narrator: Maximo suddenly found himself
entranced in the broadcast...
Tune in next time for Episode 4,
“Hot Blooded”!

Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 4: “Hot Blooded”
Maximo: Th-this is...the Pokéathlon!
Why am I getting so fired up? Why do I
feel so feverish and shaky?
Narrator: The Pokéathlon Radio
broadcast suddenly burst forth from the
radio and grabbed Maximo’s attention.
Maximo: Is this what that old guy was
talking about? Is this it?!
Narrator: Maximo suddenly started
running, to meet that strange old man,
to change himself. However...
Maximo: You guys!
Narrator: There stood the members of
Maximo’s group, Hard Punch...
Tune in next time for Episode 5,
“True Friends”!

Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 5: “True Friends”
Henchman 23: Boss! Let’s go do some
more bad stuff!
Narrator: Maximo had finally found
something he truly wanted to do, but
in front of it stood his old friends...
Maximo: Sorry, I’m not the guy I was...
Henchman 147: Huh? What are you talking
about, Boss? Are you pushing us, your
best friends, aside to become some kind
of do-gooder?
Narrator: Bam! Pow! It was obvious this
wasn’t a fair fight--one versus 214.
Young Maximo was really the leader of a
nefarious group of 214...
???: Come on! Knock it off!
Narrator: As the young Maximo was fading
in and out of consciousness, he heard a
vaguely familiar voice shout...
Tune in next time for Episode 6,
“The Old Man’s True Face”!

Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 6: “The Old Man’s True Face”
Old man: Come on! Knock off that boring
stuff and go sweat it out competing in
the Pokéathlon! Then you’ll really find
out what you’re made of!
Narrator: The strange old man that
suddenly appeared was the same one
who had invited Maximo to participate in
the Pokéathlon...
Old man: I won’t lose to any youngsters!
Bring it on! I’ll show you!
Narrator: BAM! POW!
Maximo: There’s no way that old man could
possibly win against all of my old
henchmen, right...?
Narrator: So Maximo thought... But then!
The members of “Hard Punch” fell like
dominoes...
Maximo: That... That’s impossible...
Who in the world is that old man,
anyway?!
Tune in next time for Episode 7,
“The Real Me”!

Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Episode 7: “The Real Me”
Old man: All right, get up! You definitely
have the talent to compete in the
Pokéathlon!
Narrator: Maximo thought that it was the
old man’s attacks that felled all 214 of
his former henchmen, but it was actually
the combined strength of the three
Pokémon that the old man had with him
that knocked them out.
Not aware of what really happened,
Maximo was moved.
Maximo: I... I want to compete in the
Pokéathlon, too! Please, teach me!
Old man: Ha ha...! My training regimen is
very strict!
Narrator: Maximo’s eyes sparkled with
excitement...
Maximo: ...But tell me, what is a
Pokéathlon?
Narrator: The old man fell over in
disbelief...
But anyway, the legend of young Maximo
is just beginning...
Tune in next time for the final episode,
“The Real Maximo”!

Serial Radio Drama:
The Young Pokéathlete Maximo
Final Episode: “The Real Maximo”
Maximo: All right, everyone! Pokéathlon
exercises! And...begin!
Narrator: It’s been five years since
Maximo met the old man. The naive Maximo
has grown into quite a responsible
young man.
Every so often, Maximo remembers that
old man, and wonders what he’s
doing now...
Student 8: That reminds me, where is the
old man now, Mr. Maximo?
Maximo: He went on a journey. To find
other delinquents like yourselves and
turn their lives around.
Student 214: What did you call us?!
Narrator: It’s still not known where the
strange old man did go looking for
delinquents...to help them find their
life’s goals...to become number one!
...
...The Serial Radio Drama: The Young
Pokéathlete Maximo has come to an end.

Johto Case Notes: File Number One
Our Radio Crew saw it! Heard it!
During our excavation in the ruins, we
discovered stone panels with some
strange writing carved!
Is this a message from the past? Or is it
just someone’s prank?
This program will aim a spotlight at these
kinds of issues by doing a thorough
investigation.
Please tune in!

Johto Case Notes: File Number Two
Our Radio Crew saw it! Heard it!
There’s a huge shadow of a Pokémon
swimming around the Whirl Islands!
Is it a legendary Pokémon?
Is it a new species of Pokémon?
This program will aim a spotlight at these
kinds of issues by doing a thorough
investigation.
Please tune in!

Johto Case Notes: File Number Three
Our Radio Crew saw it! Heard it!
We heard a sad voice coming from
Tohjo Falls...
Could it be the sound of the wind?
Or a Pokémon’s cry?
Was it just misheard?
This program will aim a spotlight at these
kinds of issues by doing a thorough

Please tune in!

Johto Case Notes: File Number Four
Our Radio Crew saw it! Heard it!
In the dead of night, an unmanned Magnet
Train pulled into Goldenrod Station!
Is this a ghost train?
Is this simply a reflection of a train?
This show will aim a spotlight at these
kinds of issues by doing a thorough
investigation.
Please tune in!

Johto Case Notes: File Number Five
Our Radio Crew saw it! Heard it!
There was a graceful woman dressed in
a kimono dancing to the sound of a bell
deep in the Ilex Forest!
Was it a ghost? Was it a monster? Was it a
spectre? Was it a phantom? Is it a new
species of Pokémon?
This show will aim a spotlight at these
kinds of issues by doing a thorough
investigation.
Please tune in!

East: Why... Why did I meet you just now?
Argh! Even fate is against me now!
West: Oh, East! Whatever will we do now?
Narrator: The moment their fingers
touched on the deck of the ship, their
hearts were aflame with love!
Tune in next time for another episode of
the Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!

East: West, this is such a quiet place.
It’s so wonderful isn’t it?
West: Yes, you’re right, East! It’s just
the two of us and nature! It’s just so
romantic!
Narrator: But then...an alarming sound
ripped through the beautiful atmosphere!
BWAAAAAAAAAAANNNN!!
There! On the Magnet Train tracks on
Route 32, high above the young couple!
Tune in next time for another episode of
the Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!

East: ...Huh? West, it’s started to rain!
West: You’re right, East. But it doesn’t
matter if it rains or even snows, as long
as I’m with you, I don’t care...
East: Hearing you say that makes me
happy. But if you were to catch a cold,
I’d be sad. Oh! There’s a cave here!
West: That’s so convenient! Let’s go
in there to take shelter from the rain!
Narrator: And so the young couple, hand
in hand, took shelter in the Union Cave...
Tune in next time for another episode of
the Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!

East: You know, West, there’s a very
nice path in Ecruteak City called the
“Bellchime Trail.”
Would you like to visit it with me?
West: Oh, East...if I recall correctly,
I think you have to have the Ecruteak
Gym Badge to go there...
East: What? Does that mean I’ll have to
defeat Morty first? That might be a little
difficult for me...
Narrator: The poor East isn’t good at
Pokémon battles at all...!
Tune in next time for another episode of
the Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!

West: Eek! East! H-help!
Narrator: The young couple came to
the Lake of Rage. West accidentally sat
on a GYARADOS, which is now swimming
around the lake with West on its back!
East: Oh no! West! I can’t swim! And I
don’t have any Pokémon that know Surf!
Narrator: The GYARADOS that West is
riding around on refuses to listen to
East’s attempts to get its attention!
It’s crashing through the waves on
the lake!
The Serial Radio Drama: Waves of Love!
Their love will last forever!

Pario: I rebel against society and ride a
Bicycle, trying to look cool.
But the thing I know best is Cycling Road.
I ride up Cycling Road. I ride down
Cycling Road. And then I ride back up
Cycling Road again.
After all, anyone can walk on a rail, but
to really live...
Bam! You need to do something big...
Tune in next time for episode two of the
Serial Radio Drama: Delinquent Road,
“Racing Emotions”!

Pario: I left my hometown and came to the
Johto region with the goal of becoming
the number one outcast. I’ve been riding
my Bicycle around every route in Johto.
My name is Pario!
There are tough outcasts who are good
at Pokémon battles. And there are those
who can pedal their Bicycles fast.
And there are those with three-foot-
tall pompadour hairdos!
There are still so many barriers to climb!
Tune in next time for episode three of
the Serial Radio Drama: Delinquent Road,
“A Rival Appears”!

Pario: What do you think? There isn’t a
guy around who could beat me! That
means that from today on, I am the
number one outcast!
Strange Girl: Ha ha ha! You’re certainly
full of energy...
Narrator: Suddenly a strange
girl appeared...
Pario: Who in the world are you?!
West: My name’s West. I’m the female
leader in charge of the outcasts
in Kanto.
I’ve heard all about you. 
Pario, the leader from Johto...
East: Pario, that would be you, right?
Narrator: Oh! What a surprising
development!
Tune in next time for the final episode of
the Serial Radio Drama: Delinquent Road,
“Bicycle Girl”!

Pario: You’re the leader of Kanto?
Let’s battle!
West: East, hold it just one minute. 
If we’re going to battle, are we going to
keep battling until one of us can battle
no more?
Before we do that, you should know
I’ve fallen in love with you at
first sight!
How about the two of us go...?
Pario: Is that so...
Well, the truth is, I love you, too...
Narrator: And so, the two who have just
met graduated from being tough outcasts
to the path of pure love...but that’s
another story altogether...
The Serial Radio Drama: Delinquent
Road has come to an end.
